title: ASE_NWCHEM
description: config.ini [ASE_NWCHEM] section (ASE_NWCHEM). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

nproc.description: Number of processors to use for NWChem. Can be 'auto' or an integer string.

mpi_launcher.description: MPI launcher for NWChem (mpirun default, or srun on Slurm).

multiplicity.description: Spin multiplicity for the NWChem calculation.

scf_maxiter.description: Maximum number of SCF iterations for NWChem.

basis.description: NWChem basis set passed to the ASE calculator.

memory.description: NWChem memory string passed to the ASE calculator.
